findings.summary: the test counts roadmap builds around obligation_snapshot.sweep, whose reachable modules contain no roadmap reference, so the zero is structural and the done_when's negative control cannot reproduce.
assert second == first compares two sweeps of the same code and fixture, so both sides move together and the equal-to-base-sweep requirement is unmeasured.
the positive control calls the patched roadmap_module.build_roadmap itself, proving the wrapper is installed rather than that the sweep reaches a build.
the base arm runs a different test file under a literal base-tree placeholder, so no base comparison for the landed test can be re-run.
plan-verdict=passed contradicts the fragment's own body, which records the negative control as unreproducible and two arms unrun.

VERDICT goal: the reviewed run's goal (prompt.txt:38) is "make this hold: the obligations sweep builds the roadmap once per pass"; the landed test asserts at most one build but changes no source module, and the sweep it exercises at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:2431 contains no roadmap build at all, so the bound holds by absence rather than by a guard.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when (node.json) names a 40-item two-project sweep, obligations equal to a base sweep, a negative control above two at base, ten staged sweeps under 30 s, and an all_debug run at -n 4; the manifest records only the zero count and a 3-test pass, and records the timing arm and composed arms as not run.
VERDICT write_paths: the diff touches tests/test_an_obligations_sweep_builds_the_roadmap_once.py and docs/evidence/fragments/dispatch-admission-and-landing-take-seconds/daalt-the-obligations-sweep-builds-the-roadmap-once-per-pass.html, both inside the declared paths; the three declared source modules were not changed.
VERDICT manifest: read at the reviewed run directory; it reports status complete, 0 roadmap builds at base for 40 review items, a focused gate of 3 passed, and a negative control that refuses 40 builds; its baseline_suite names a different test file and a command carrying an unsubstituted PYTHONPATH placeholder.
VERDICT diff: read changeset by changeset (555fb3db8f, 8452b00f11, 1787f1d0ce, fc301c39b6) against 1f914072e1; two new files and 194 insertions, with no source or test-of-source change.

SCORE durability: 6
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_an_obligations_sweep_builds_the_roadmap_once.py:175 compares two sweeps of the same code and fixture, so both sides move together and a regression in the derivation leaves it true.
SCORE fit: 15
JUSTIFICATION fit: the test follows the surrounding pytest idiom and naming, though tests/test_an_obligations_sweep_builds_the_roadmap_once.py:128 binds the private roadmap_module._build_roadmap and the file ends without a trailing newline.
SCORE reuse: 12
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the counting wrapper at tests/test_an_obligations_sweep_builds_the_roadmap_once.py:124 duplicates the existing roadmap-build counter at tests/test_a_dispatch_reads_one_sections_readiness.py:263, and the once-per-pass capability named by the reviewer's goal is already owned by reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:203 _built_once without being extended.
FINDING tests/test_an_obligations_sweep_builds_the_roadmap_once.py:158 blocking: the test counts roadmap builds around obligation_snapshot.sweep, whose reachable modules (reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py and reckon/crew/obligations.py) contain no roadmap reference at all, so the zero is structural and cannot distinguish the defect being absent from the defect's path being unreached; the done_when's negative control consequently cannot reproduce and the plan's per-item build claim is left unmeasured.
FINDING tests/test_an_obligations_sweep_builds_the_roadmap_once.py:175 non-blocking: `assert second == first` compares two sweeps of the same code and the same fixture, so both sides move together and the done_when's equal-to-base-sweep requirement is never measured, while the docstring at :172 claims a base comparison the body does not make.
FINDING tests/test_an_obligations_sweep_builds_the_roadmap_once.py:152 non-blocking: the positive control calls the patched roadmap_module.build_roadmap itself, so it proves only that the wrapper is installed, not that the sweep reaches a build; it cannot license reading the zero in :158 as evidence about the sweep.
